subject: Portal Access & Evidence Ownership Delegation — HeliosPay SOC2/SIG
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@heliospay.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@heliospay.com
Date: Mon, 01 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence handover & delegated ownership for portal intake (SOC2/SIG)

Hi Hannah / Vanessa,

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement needs a few operational confirmations before we can push the PO through:

- We need a named evidence owner for your Vendor Portal (Vendr) who will accept responsibility for uploading SOC2 artifacts and responding to SIG/CAIQ questions.
- If possible, HeliosPay would prefer a delegated "evidence steward" role so our security team can receive automated attestations and download redacted reports.
- Timeline: procurement target is two weeks (by 2028-04-15).

I've attached a redacted SOC2 report we've used for other vendors as an example of what we'll accept. Can you confirm who on your side will be the primary contact and whether Redwood can create a service account / delegated role in Vendr or OneTrust for this scope?

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Vendor Risk — HeliosPay
-- attachment: HeliosPay_SOC2_redacted.pdf (PDF)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@heliospay.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 01 Apr 2028 10:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence handover & delegated ownership for portal intake (SOC2/SIG)

Hi Liam — appreciate the clarity and the sample. Tagging the operations and security leads here to coordinate. Quick plan:

1) Ownership: Vanessa will act as the primary evidence steward for the Vendr/OneTrust profile. Marcus will be backup and will manage technical uploads (S3 presign / API). Mina will own mapping our CAIQ answers to your baseline and handling any redaction requests.

2) Portal access options: we can either (a) create a delegated "evidence steward" account in Vendr with scoped permissions, or (b) provision a Redwood-managed service account that HeliosPay can subscribe to (read-only download + attestations). We prefer (a) for auditability but both are doable.

3) Data / SSO: do you require SSO integration (IdP) for the steward account or is an email-based invite sufficient? Also confirm retention SLA for any evidence we upload.

Proposed mutual action plan (high-level):
- Today: confirm preferred portal & steward contact (you) + SSO requirement
- By 2028-04-03: Redwood creates delegated role or service account and shares onboarding steps
- By 2028-04-10: Upload initial SOC2 artifact and pre-seed CAIQ answers; HeliosPay reviews
- By 2028-04-15: Final attestations completed for procurement

Can you confirm Ana (cc'd on security@heliospay.com) should be the Helios contact for uploads?

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Security & Compliance Operations — Redwood Inference

From: Ana Gomez <ana@heliospay.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam@heliospay.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Apr 2028 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence handover & delegated ownership for portal intake (SOC2/SIG)

Thanks Hannah — confirmed, I'll be the HeliosPay intake lead. A few quick answers:

- Preferred portal: Vendr (we use Vendr links in our procurement workflows). If you can push artifacts there and grant a scoped owner role, that's ideal.
- SSO: optional but preferred. Our IdP is okta.com (domain: heliospay.okta.com). We can provide metadata if you choose SSO.
- Retention SLA: procurement requires evidence to be accessible for at least 12 months after upload.

I've attached our CAIQ baseline spreadsheet (we filled a few fields to speed things up). If Redwood can pre-seed the CAIQ answers and mark which fields still require confirmation, that would be extremely helpful.

Ana
Ana Gomez
Security Program Manager — HeliosPay
-- attachment: HeliosPay_CAIQ_baseline.xlsx (Excel)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Ana Gomez <ana@heliospay.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 05 Apr 2028 15:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence handover & delegated ownership for portal intake (SOC2/SIG)

Ana / team — thanks for the quick responses and the CAIQ baseline. Summary of actions and owners (we'll update the HubSpot ticket once completed):

- Create Vendr delegated role: Vanessa (owner) — ETA 2028-04-03 
  - Scope: upload/download evidence, respond to QnA, generate attestations.
  - Optional: enable SSO via HeliosPay Okta (we'll request IdP metadata).

- Pre-seed CAIQ answers from HeliosPay spreadsheet: Mina (owner) — ETA 2028-04-06
  - Mina will flag items needing technical confirmation and mark required attachments per question.

- Upload redacted SOC2 and link to portal: Marcus (owner) — ETA 2028-04-10
  - Marcus will use our presigned S3 flow and confirm retention policy meets 12-month requirement.

Open questions for HeliosPay:
- Confirm SSO metadata or confirm that email-based invite is acceptable.
- Any special redaction rules beyond standard (PII, vendor-only billing data)

Logs / references: HubSpot ticket HP-7821 will track progress: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/ticket/HP-7821
Vendr portal preview: https://vendr.example.com/portal/heliospay

I'll follow up with the Vendr invitation once role is created. If procurement needs an interim note confirming these milestones for the PO, we can draft one (Hannah, can we produce a short operational note for Liam's procurement?).

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Vendor Security Lead — Redwood Inference
